# kinu LLM Coding Reference

This file is a machine-friendly, exhaustive reference for coding agents using kinu. It focuses on what each component enhances, what it is for, and which props are specific to kinu beyond native HTML attributes.

## Core model

- kinu components are thin wrappers over semantic HTML and platform primitives.
- Components forward native attributes directly whenever possible.
- Styling and states are primarily CSS-driven using `p="..."` attribute selectors.
- When a component enhances `<button>`, `<input>`, `<dialog>`, etc, assume native props/events are also valid unless explicitly overridden.

## Package import

```tsx
import {Button, Input, Dialog} from 'kinu';
```

## Component index

- **Accordion** (slug: `accordion`) — Disclosure built on the native `<details>` element with smooth open and close animation. Exports: Accordion.
- **Alert** (slug: `alert`) — Inline status message with tone variants. Exports: Alert.
- **Alert Dialog** (slug: `alert-dialog`) — Alias of Dialog with alert-focused styling defaults. Exports: AlertDialog.
- **Aspect Ratio** (slug: `aspect-ratio`) — Maintains responsive boxes at a fixed ratio using pure CSS. Exports: AspectRatio.
- **Avatar** (slug: `avatar`) — Styled `<img>` avatar that falls back to initials from the alt text. Exports: Avatar.
- **Badge** (slug: `badge`) — Tiny inline status indicator with multiple tone variants. Exports: Badge.
- **Breadcrumb** (slug: `breadcrumb`) — Composable breadcrumb trail built from list primitives. Exports: Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink.
- **Button** (slug: `button`) — Button component that forwards props to `<button>` or `<a>` when href is provided. Exports: Button.
- **Calendar** (slug: `calendar`) — Styled wrapper around the native `<input type="date">` element. Exports: Calendar.
- **Card** (slug: `card`) — Surface container with padding, border, and typography defaults. Exports: Card.
- **Carousel** (slug: `carousel`) — Scroll snapping carousel with previous/next helpers. Exports: Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselPrevious, CarouselNext.
- **Checkbox** (slug: `checkbox`) — Accessible checkbox input with custom visuals. Exports: Checkbox.
- **Collapsible** (slug: `collapsible`) — Minimal hide/show container built on `<details>` without default markers. Exports: Collapsible.
- **Combobox** (slug: `combobox`) — Autocomplete input with trigger, list, and option primitives. Exports: ComboboxInput, ComboboxList, ComboboxOption, Combobox.
- **Context Menu** (slug: `context-menu`) — Right-click context menu powered by the native dialog element. Exports: ContextMenuTrigger, ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem.
- **File Upload** (slug: `file-upload`) — Native file input with a styled button for selecting local files. Exports: FileUpload.
- **Color Picker** (slug: `color-picker`) — Styled color swatch input that opens the native OS color picker. Exports: ColorPicker.
- **Date Picker** (slug: `date-picker`) — Styled date input that shares the same foundation as Calendar. Exports: DatePicker.
- **Time Picker** (slug: `time-picker`) — Styled time input that shares the same foundation as Date Picker. Exports: TimePicker.
- **Dialog** (slug: `dialog`) — Composable modal built on the native `<dialog>` element. Exports: Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogClose.
- **Drawer** (slug: `drawer`) — Bottom sheet style overlay with trigger and close helpers. Exports: Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent, DrawerClose.
- **Dropdown Menu** (slug: `dropdown-menu`) — Command-driven dropdown built on top of `<dialog>`. Exports: DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem.
- **Hover Card** (slug: `hover-card`) — Delayed hover preview card with trigger/content primitives. Exports: HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent.
- **Input** (slug: `input`) — Text input with size, tone, and invalid states handled in CSS. Exports: Input.
- **Input Group** (slug: `input-group`) — Compact fieldset wrapper for joined controls like input and button rows. Exports: InputGroup.
- **Label** (slug: `label`) — Typography-aligned label component for form controls. Exports: Label.
- **Menubar** (slug: `menubar`) — Horizontal command bar composed of styled buttons. Exports: Menubar, MenubarItem.
- **Navigation Menu** (slug: `navigation-menu`) — Composable navigation with list, item, and link helpers. Exports: NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuLink.
- **Pagination** (slug: `pagination`) — Semantic pagination list with previous/next helpers. Exports: Pagination, PaginationList, PaginationItem, PaginationLink.
- **Popover** (slug: `popover`) — Lightweight popover using native dialog with trigger/content primitives. Exports: Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverClose.
- **Progress** (slug: `progress`) — Styled progress meter with determinate and indeterminate states. Exports: Progress.
- **Radio Group** (slug: `radio-group`) — Container that styles a set of native radio inputs. Exports: RadioGroup, Radio.
- **Resizable** (slug: `resizable`) — Resizable container that exposes native CSS handles. Exports: Resizable.
- **Scroll Area** (slug: `scroll-area`) — Overflow wrapper with custom scrollbars and shadow indicators. Exports: ScrollArea.
- **Select** (slug: `select`) — Styled native `<select>` element with size variants. Exports: Select.
- **Separator** (slug: `separator`) — Semantic horizontal or vertical divider. Exports: Separator.
- **Sheet** (slug: `sheet`) — Side or bottom sheet overlay with directional variants. Exports: Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetClose.
- **Sidebar** (slug: `sidebar`) — Responsive sidebar dialog that collapses on mobile. Exports: SidebarTrigger, Sidebar.
- **Spinner** (slug: `spinner`) — Inline loading indicator for compact pending states. Exports: Spinner.
- **Skeleton** (slug: `skeleton`) — Animated shimmer placeholder for loading states. Exports: Skeleton.
- **Slider** (slug: `slider`) — Range input with CSS-driven track and thumb styling. Exports: Slider.
- **Switch** (slug: `switch`) — Accessible toggle switch built from a checkbox input. Exports: Switch.
- **Table** (slug: `table`) — Table wrapper with zebra striping and compact density. Exports: Table.
- **Tabs** (slug: `tabs`) — TabList, Tab, and TabPanel wrappers using aria attributes. Exports: TabList, Tab, TabPanel.
- **Textarea** (slug: `textarea`) — Text area with matching input styling, variants, and sizes. Exports: Textarea.
- **Toggle** (slug: `toggle`) — ARIA-pressed aware button for on/off interactions. Exports: Toggle.
- **Toggle Group** (slug: `toggle-group`) — Container that lets Toggle buttons coordinate pressed state. Exports: ToggleGroup.
- **Tooltip** (slug: `tooltip`) — Hover/focus tooltip with placement attributes and CSS timing. Exports: Tooltip.
- **Tree** (slug: `tree`) — Composable tree view built from native `<details>` and `<summary>` primitives. Exports: Tree.

## Accordion

- **Purpose:** Disclosure built on the native `<details>` element with smooth open and close animation.
- **Notes:** Forwards every native `<details>` attribute so you can control open state. Provide your own `<summary>` element to define the trigger.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/accordion/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Accordion} from 'kinu';

<Accordion open>
  <summary>Details</summary>
  <p>Hidden content</p>
</Accordion>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Accordion | Collapsible section | <details> |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### Accordion

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open | `boolean` | — | Controls the open state of the details element. |


## Alert

- **Purpose:** Inline status message with tone variants.
- **Notes:** Renders a `<div>` so you can include any markup you need.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/alert/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Alert} from 'kinu';

<Alert variant="default">Heads up!</Alert>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Alert | Status message | <div> |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### Alert

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | `"destructive"` | 'default' | Visual style variant. |


## Alert Dialog

- **Purpose:** Alias of Dialog with alert-focused styling defaults.
- **Notes:** Re-exports Dialog so you get Trigger, Content, Close, and other helpers. Use when you want dialog markup that communicates a destructive decision.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/alert-dialog/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {AlertDialog} from 'kinu';

<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialog.Trigger>Delete</AlertDialog.Trigger>
  <AlertDialog.Content>Confirm action</AlertDialog.Content>
</AlertDialog>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AlertDialog | Alert modal | Custom composition (see source) |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### AlertDialog

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |


## Aspect Ratio

- **Purpose:** Maintains responsive boxes at a fixed ratio using pure CSS.
- **Notes:** Wraps a `<div>` that defines the ratio using a CSS custom property.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/aspect-ratio/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {AspectRatio} from 'kinu';

<AspectRatio ratio="16 / 9">
  <img src="..." alt="Video thumbnail" />
</AspectRatio>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AspectRatio | Ratio container | Custom composition (see source) |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### AspectRatio

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ratio | `string` | — | Aspect ratio expressed as a CSS ratio string (e.g. "16 / 9"). |


## Avatar

- **Purpose:** Styled `<img>` avatar that falls back to initials from the alt text.
- **Notes:** Uses the alt attribute content as a CSS-rendered fallback when the image fails. Override dimensions in CSS if you need sizes other than the 2rem default.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/avatar/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Avatar} from 'kinu';

<Avatar alt="JM" src="/user.jpg" />
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Avatar | User profile image | Custom composition (see source) |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### Avatar

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| src | `string` | — | Image source for the avatar. |
| alt | `string` | — | Alt text used by the image and for fallback initials. |
| children | `element.children` | — | Fallback initials or text rendered via the alt attribute. |
| size | `AvatarSize` | — | Size preset for the avatar. |

- **Purpose:** Tiny inline status indicator with multiple tone variants.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | `BadgeVariant` | 'default' | Visual style variant. |


## Breadcrumb

- **Purpose:** Composable breadcrumb trail built from list primitives.
- **Notes:** Ships structural wrappers so you can supply router-aware links. Uses semantic list markup for accessibility.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/breadcrumb/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList} from 'kinu';

<Breadcrumb>
  <BreadcrumbList>
    <BreadcrumbItem><BreadcrumbLink href="/">Home</BreadcrumbLink></BreadcrumbItem>
  </BreadcrumbList>
</Breadcrumb>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Breadcrumb | Navigation trail | <nav> |
| BreadcrumbList | Trail container | <ol> |
| BreadcrumbItem | Trail item | <li> |
| BreadcrumbLink | Trail link | <a> |

## Button

- **Purpose:** Button component that forwards props to `<button>` or `<a>` when href is provided.
- **Notes:** Use the loading attribute to reflect pending state without extra handlers. Supports size attributes (sm, md, lg, icon) controlled purely with CSS.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/button/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Button} from 'kinu';

<Button variant="outline">Action</Button>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Button | Interactive action control | Custom composition (see source) |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### Button

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | `ButtonVariant` | 'default' | Visual style variant. |
| size | `ButtonSize` | 'md' | Size preset for the button. |
| loading | `boolean` | — | Shows a pending state and disables interactions. |
| href | `string` | — | When provided, renders the Button as an anchor element. |
| target | `string | undefined | null` | — | Target for anchor elements. |
| rel | `string | undefined | null` | — | Relationship between the current page and the linked resource. |
| onClick | `(event: MouseEvent) => void | null` | — | Click handler for the button. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disables interactions and applies disabled styling. |
| type | `string | undefined | null` | — | Button type attribute. |


## Calendar

- **Purpose:** Styled wrapper around the native `<input type="date">` element.
- **Notes:** Forwards every standard input attribute, defaulting type to "date". Uses the browser's native date picker UI for accessibility and localisation.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/calendar/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Calendar} from 'kinu';

<Calendar />
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Calendar | Date picker | <input> |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### Calendar

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Current date value. |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for date input. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the input. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |

## Carousel

- **Purpose:** Scroll snapping carousel with previous/next helpers.
- **Notes:** Leverages CSS scroll snap for buttery momentum. Content remains fully declarative.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/carousel/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious} from 'kinu';

<Carousel>
  <CarouselContent>
    <CarouselItem>Slide</CarouselItem>
  </CarouselContent>
  <CarouselPrevious />
  <CarouselNext />
</Carousel>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Carousel | Image slider | Custom composition (see source) |
| CarouselContent | Slider content | Custom composition (see source) |
| CarouselItem | Slide item | <div> |
| CarouselPrevious | Previous button | Custom composition (see source) |
| CarouselNext | Next button | Custom composition (see source) |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### Carousel

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the carousel content. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |


## Checkbox

- **Purpose:** Accessible checkbox input with custom visuals.
- **Notes:** Wraps `<input type="checkbox">` so forms just work. Supports data-state="indeterminate" styling for tri-state usage.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/checkbox/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Checkbox} from 'kinu';

<Checkbox checked aria-label="Accept" />
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Checkbox | Selection control | <input> |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### Checkbox

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| checked | `boolean` | — | Controls the checked state. |
| data-state | `"indeterminate"` | — | Marks the checkbox as indeterminate for styling. |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for the checkbox. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the checkbox. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Input value used for form submissions. |


## Collapsible

### Usage

import {Collapsible} from 'kinu';

<Collapsible open summary="Trigger">Hidden content</Collapsible>

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open | `boolean` | — | Controls the open state of the details element. |


## Combobox

- **Purpose:** Autocomplete input with trigger, list, and option primitives.
- **Notes:** Uses command/commandFor attributes for disclosure logic. Keep option counts manageable for usability.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/combobox/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Combobox, ComboboxInput, ComboboxList, ComboboxOption} from 'kinu';

<Combobox>
  <ComboboxInput placeholder="Search" />
  <ComboboxList>
    <ComboboxOption>One</ComboboxOption>
  </ComboboxList>
</Combobox>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ComboboxInput | Search input | <input> |
| ComboboxList | Results list | <dialog> |
| ComboboxOption | Result option | <button> |
| Combobox | Autocomplete input | Custom composition (see source) |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### ComboboxInput

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Input value for controlled usage. |
| placeholder | `string` | — | Placeholder text for the input. |
| onInput | `(event: InputEvent) => void` | — | Change handler for controlled inputs. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the input. |

#### ComboboxOption

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| selected | `boolean` | — | Marks the option as selected for styling. |
| shortcut | `string` | — | Optional shortcut hint rendered on the trailing edge. |
| destructive | `boolean` | — | Applies destructive styling to the option. |


## Context Menu

- **Purpose:** Right-click context menu powered by the native dialog element.
- **Notes:** Installs the commands polyfill when rendered. Menu content is focus-trapped via `<dialog>`.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/context-menu/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuTrigger} from 'kinu';

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger>Right click this area</ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent>
    <ContextMenuItem>Copy</ContextMenuItem>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ContextMenuTrigger | Menu trigger | Custom composition (see source) |
| ContextMenu | Right-click menu | Custom composition (see source) |
| ContextMenuContent | Menu content | Custom composition (see source) |
| ContextMenuItem | Menu item | <button> |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### ContextMenu

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the context menu dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

#### ContextMenuContent

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |

#### ContextMenuItem

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| selected | `boolean` | — | Marks the item as selected for styling. |
| shortcut | `string` | — | Optional shortcut hint rendered on the trailing edge. |
| destructive | `boolean` | — | Applies destructive styling to the item. |


## File Upload

- **Purpose:** Native file input with a styled button for selecting local files.
- **Notes:** Sets type="file" for you and forwards all native input props. Use the accept prop to restrict selectable file types. Use capture="user" or capture="environment" to invoke the camera on mobile.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/file-upload/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {FileUpload} from 'kinu';

<FileUpload accept="image/*" />
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FileUpload | Component | <input> |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### FileUpload

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler called when the user selects files. |
| accept | `string` | — | Allowed file types as MIME types or extensions (e.g. "image/*" or ".pdf"). |
| multiple | `boolean` | — | Allow selecting multiple files. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the input. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |


## Color Picker

- **Purpose:** Styled color swatch input that opens the native OS color picker.
- **Notes:** Sets type="color" for you and forwards all native input props. Pairs naturally with `Input` inside an `InputGroup` to show an editable hex value alongside the swatch.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/color-picker/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {ColorPicker} from 'kinu';

<ColorPicker />
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ColorPicker | Component | <input> |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### ColorPicker

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Current color value as a hex string (e.g. "#ff0000"). |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for the color input. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the input. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |

| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |


## Time Picker

- **Purpose:** Styled time input that shares the same foundation as Date Picker.
- **Notes:** Sets type="time" for you and forwards all native input props. Use the step prop to constrain selectable intervals, e.g. step={1800} for 30-minute increments.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/time-picker/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {TimePicker} from 'kinu';

<TimePicker />
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TimePicker | Component | <input> |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### TimePicker

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Current time value in HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format. |
| onChange | `(event: Event) => void` | — | Change handler for time input. |
| disabled | `boolean` | — | Disable the input. |
| name | `string` | — | Input name used for form submissions. |
| step | `number` | 60 | Granularity of the time value in seconds.
Common values: 60 (1 min), 900 (15 min), 1800 (30 min). |


## Dialog

- **Purpose:** Composable modal built on the native `<dialog>` element.
- **Notes:** Relies on command attributes instead of portal gymnastics. Dialog.Content forwards all native `<dialog>` props.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/dialog/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogTrigger} from 'kinu';

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger><Button>Open</Button></DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent>Modal body</DialogContent>
  <DialogClose><Button>Close</Button></DialogClose>
</Dialog>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dialog | Modal overlay | Custom composition (see source) |
| DialogTrigger | Dialog trigger | Custom composition (see source) |
| DialogContent | Dialog content | Custom composition (see source) |
| DialogClose | Close button | Custom composition (see source) |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### Dialog

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

#### DialogContent

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |

### Static helpers / attached members

- `Dialog.Trigger = DialogTrigger`
- `Dialog.Content = DialogContent`
- `Dialog.Close = DialogClose`

## Dropdown Menu

- **Purpose:** Command-driven dropdown built on top of `<dialog>`.
- **Notes:** Menu items render as `<button>` elements by default. Automatically closes when an item dispatches the close command.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/dropdown-menu/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger} from 'kinu';

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger><Button>Open</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent>
    <DropdownMenuItem>Item</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DropdownMenu | Dropdown menu | Custom composition (see source) |
| DropdownMenuTrigger | Menu trigger | Custom composition (see source) |
| DropdownMenuContent | Menu content | Custom composition (see source) |
| DropdownMenuItem | Menu item | Custom composition (see source) |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### DropdownMenu

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `string` | — | Optional ID for the dropdown content. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

#### DropdownMenuContent

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |
| command | `string` | 'close' | Command dispatched when the dialog receives the command event. |
| commandFor | `string` | — | Target dialog identifier for the command dispatch. |
| to | `"left"` | — | Align the menu panel to the trigger's left or right edge. |

#### DropdownMenuItem

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| href | `string` | — | When provided, renders the item as an anchor element. |
| selected | `boolean` | — | Marks the item as selected for styling. |
| shortcut | `string` | — | Optional shortcut hint rendered on the trailing edge. |
| destructive | `boolean` | — | Applies destructive styling to the item. |

- **Primary source:** `src/components/tooltip/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Tooltip} from 'kinu';

<Tooltip text="Info"><Button>Hover</Button></Tooltip>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tooltip | Hover hint | <span> |

### kinu-specific props

Native HTML props are also supported according to the enhanced element type.

#### Tooltip

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `string` | — | Tooltip text provided via the title attribute. |
| side | `"left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom"` | — | The direction the tooltip should open towards. |


## Tree

- **Purpose:** Composable tree view built from native `<details>` and `<summary>` primitives.
- **Notes:** State is native via the `open` attribute on `Tree.Group`. Nest `Tree.Group` inside `Tree.GroupItems` for deeper hierarchies.
- **Primary source:** `src/components/tree/index.tsx`

### Usage

```tsx
import {Tree} from 'kinu';

<Tree>
  <Tree.Group open>
    <Tree.GroupLabel>src</Tree.GroupLabel>
    <Tree.GroupItems>
      <Tree.Item>index.ts</Tree.Item>
    </Tree.GroupItems>
  </Tree.Group>
</Tree>
```

### Exports and enhanced HTML

| Export | Purpose | Enhanced HTML element(s) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tree | Tree view | Custom composition (see source) |
